name: letta-message
title: Letta Message
description: Flat structure summary of the Letta Message entity, derived from the Letta OpenAPI 1.0.0 spec.

fields.name: created_by_id
fields.description: The id of the user that made this object.

fields.name: last_updated_by_id
fields.description: The id of the user that made this object.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: The timestamp when the object was created.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.description: The timestamp when the object was last updated.

fields.name: id
fields.description: The human-friendly ID of the Message

fields.name: agent_id
fields.description: The unique identifier of the agent.

fields.name: model
fields.description: The model used to make the function call.

fields.name: content
fields.description: The content of the message.

fields.name: name
fields.description: For role user/assistant: the (optional) name of the participant. For role tool/function: the name of the function called.

fields.name: tool_calls
fields.description: The list of tool calls requested. Only applicable for role assistant.

fields.name: tool_call_id
fields.description: The ID of the tool call. Only applicable for role tool.

fields.name: step_id
fields.description: The id of the step that this message was created in.

fields.name: run_id
fields.description: The id of the run that this message was created in.

fields.name: otid
fields.description: The offline threading id associated with this message

fields.name: tool_returns
fields.description: Tool execution return information for prior tool calls

fields.name: group_id
fields.description: The multi-agent group that the message was sent in

fields.name: sender_id
fields.description: The id of the sender of the message, can be an identity id or agent id

fields.name: batch_item_id
fields.description: The id of the LLMBatchItem that this message is associated with

fields.name: conversation_id
fields.description: The conversation this message belongs to

fields.name: is_err
fields.description: Whether this message is part of an error step. Used only for debugging purposes.

fields.name: approval_request_id
fields.description: The id of the approval request if this message is associated with a tool call request.

fields.name: approve
fields.description: Whether tool call is approved.

fields.name: denial_reason
fields.description: The reason the tool call request was denied.

fields.name: approvals
fields.description: The list of approvals for this message.
